includeLivingCosts.title: Include Living Costs
includeLivingCosts.description: Optional: true to add estimated food, housing, books, transport and personal costs.

isInternational.title: International Student
isInternational.description: Optional: true if the student will study on an F-1 visa.

program.title: Program
program.description: Program name or code, e.g. MS in Business Analytics or MSBA.

studyMode.title: Study Mode
studyMode.description: Optional: Full-time or Part-time. Use Part-time when the student says they will study part-time or keep working; leave blank for full-time.
